{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Yamm|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Yamm''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores {{MCW|Depth Strider}} II, {{MCW|Riptide}} I, {{MCW|Aqua Affinity}} and {{MCW|Respiration}} II. It is crafted from four nautilus shells, and stores four enchantments, more than any other blessing.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/depth_strider_riptide_aqua_affinity_respiration.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Yamm" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Yamm is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Depth Strider applies to boots, Riptide to tridents, and Aqua Affinity and Respiration to helmets.
